name: srwf-kor-patch
description: Local-first static patcher for accepted SRWF Korean patch releases

scripts.build: python3 scripts/verify_repo.py && node --test && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest tests/test_verify_repo.py
scripts.test: node --test && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest tests/test_verify_repo.py && python3 scripts/verify_repo.py
